caption:
Storm rolls through. Every roofer's phone lights up at once, while you're already up on someone else's roof.
The callers you don't get back to might ring the next roofer on the list.
TradeReach texts each missed caller back within moments, asks single or double storey and for photos from the ground, and flags storm leaks to you straight away.
